fromcp.description: Convert numerical arguments from this encoding. Multibyte encodings supported.

io_charset.description: I/O character set. Use UTF-8 for maximal pleasure on UTF-8 capable terminals.

add_charset.description: Show hexadecimal representation of displayed characters in this additional charset.

colour.description: Use colour codes: on, off, or auto.

max_count.description: Maximal number of codepoints to display. Use 0 for unlimited.

verbose.description: Be more verbose about displayed characters, e.g. display Unihan information.

brief.description: Display character information in brief format.

brexit_ascii.description: Display ASCII table (EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement 2020 version).

inputs.description: List of input strings or codepoints to query. Each item is a flat map with 'value' and optional 'type'. 'type' overrides auto-guessing. Valid types: hex, decimal, octal, binary, regexp, string, auto. If 'type' is omitted, auto is used implicitly by the tool, but here we can specify flags if needed. If 'value' is omitted, it's a flag-only entry? No, inputs are args. This list represents the positional arguments with their type hints if applicable via flags passed before them.
